scope.head: bee8868b9cc6a98149f7f428a38d29969ad45924
scope.range: Current uncommitted Stage B Host qualification and exact Pi native integration, compared with bee8868

positive_observations: The selected Pi path is CLI-only and correctly has no dedicated ACP or Pi fetch capability claim.
Native Pi tools are restored from the installed tool inventory and mediated through the registered permission handler before execution.
Runtime, package, node, policy, launch arguments, and permission-envelope identity are rechecked before spawning.
The native receipt records successful in-root work and matching denied outside-root, protected-root, shell, and loopback attempts with truthful terminal results.
Writer-boundary, result publication, and changed-file validation remain integrated with the existing delegation worker path.
limitations: Qualification is explicitly verified-local for the pinned Pi 0.85.1 identity and does not establish a general network sandbox or installation claim.
Read locations remain unrestricted and existing HOME-based authentication remains reachable.
The loopback curl observation is an execute denial; no nonexistent dedicated Pi fetch callback is claimed.
Concurrent external symlink swapping remains outside the isolated single-writer guarantee.
The inspected release log excerpt does not independently establish completion of the final full release rerun.
